# Digital2Real Templates

This directory owns canonical templates for governed Digital2Real documents.

## Templates

- [Capability Specification](capability-specification-template.md)
- [Experience Brief](experience-brief-template.md)
- [Assessment Specification](assessment-specification-template.md)
- [Architecture Decision Record](architecture-decision-record-template.md)

This directory must contain reusable structure only. Product-specific, vendor-specific, or capability-specific content does not belong here.
